design_bible.composition: One independent readable portrait phone per image; consistent graphite frame and slim ivory outer margins
design_bible.typography: System San Francisco/PingFang-like; comfortable 17 pt Chinese body and 22 pt title concept targets
design_bible.spacing: 20 pt page margins; 24 pt vertical rhythm; generous touch controls
design_bible.surfaces: Matte reading content; restrained optical translucency limited to navigation and composer; approval uses foreground sheet and dimmed background
design_bible.navigation: Conversation-first root, sidebar trigger, object review as dismissible sheet
design_bible.identity: No generated replacement icon or mascot; preserved A1 remains outside these concept images

images.role: Independent conversation and intelligent-UI visual direction

review.Chinese_copy: Specified core text visibly readable; no private content
strengths: Warm canvas, near-black text and indigo actions read as one restrained system
Assistant prose is printed directly on the canvas
Local comparison and explicit continuation are distinct
limitations: Generated candidate rows have extra enclosing borders; flatten into divided rows in the interaction prototype
Static art does not prove glass optics, Dynamic Type, touch dimensions, gestures or reading stability
The 887 px composition is a reference, not a native pixel specification

images.role: Independent exact-action human-in-the-loop sheet visual direction

reference_images.role: Design bible, device scale, palette and typography reference only; no crop

review.Chinese_copy: Specified object, time, target calendar, revision, impact and four actions visibly readable
strengths: Grabber and dismiss X are distinct from refusal
Confirmation, edit, later and refusal are all visible in the lower action area
Pending approval has no success mark
limitations: Static art does not prove fixed-footer behavior at alternate detents, keyboard or accessibility sizes
Date, target and content are synthetic fixture data
Actual effect and receipt remain subject to existing typed contracts

scope_note: Concept images guide visual direction only. They do not replace UX-1 or CGUI-1 behavior contracts, do not grant execution authority and cannot close native or final product acceptance. Current progress remains only in docs/status/master-plan.md.
